title: Atlas DataFlow Dataset Integration Authoring Manifest
description: Project Spec S0166. The principal, immutable-per-authoring-generation index for one dataset-specific Atlas authoring generation. Owns coordination metadata only -- dataset identity, authoring-generation identity, the selected capability-profile identity/version, a role-keyed inventory of safe relative artifact references with contract/version identity and SHA-256 integrity, compact provenance, and boundary confirmations. It must never embed complete discovery evidence, a complete semantic-intent payload, a complete preparation recipe, training metrics, model-selection payload, model bytes, an inference-bundle payload, visual payloads, or an absolute external project root; it references those narrow artifacts instead of duplicating them. This manifest is not an external_analysis_handoff replacement and must never contain an operational importer instruction -- external corroboration is represented only as logical producer identity in the provenance section, never as an external filesystem root.

safe_relative_reference.description: Portable, repository/package-relative reference. Rejects absolute POSIX paths, Windows drive paths, UNC/backslash paths, parent traversal, empty and dot-only paths, and repeated separators.

schema_version.description: Schema version for this authoring manifest document.

artifact_type.description: Explicit artifact type identifying this document as the principal dataset-integration authoring manifest.

dataset_identity.description: This manifest is dataset-specific: it governs exactly one dataset.

authoring_generation.description: Explicit, immutable authoring-generation identity this manifest represents. A new authoring decision requires a new authoring_generation_id and a new manifest instance, never an in-place mutation of this one.

capability_profile_selection.description: Typed identity/version selection of the capability profile governing this authoring generation's role applicability and semantic requirements. Never a dataset slug, filesystem check, or placeholder.

capability_profile_ref.description: Optional safe relative reference to the concrete capability-profile document, for integrity-bound resolution alongside the typed id/version selection above.

artifact_references.description: Role-keyed inventory of narrow artifact references this authoring generation coordinates. Each entry references, rather than duplicates, its narrow artifact payload. Role applicability (required/optional/forbidden) is resolved from the selected capability profile, not stored redundantly here.

role.description: Stable artifact role identifier. Every reference must declare a role identity; a reference without one is rejected.

path.description: Safe relative reference to the concrete narrow artifact. Absolute filesystem paths and path traversal escaping the repository/package boundary are rejected.

sha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 of the referenced artifact's bytes.

contract_version.description: Contract/schema version identifier of the referenced artifact, e.g. 'dataset-discovery-evidence.v1'.

provenance.description: Compact provenance records for this authoring generation's artifacts, per S0163's decision to keep provenance a section of the principal manifest rather than a separate top-level artifact. Uses logical producer/artifact identity; never an external filesystem root. A missing external producer revision is representable explicitly via producer_revision_known=false rather than a fabricated value.

logical_producer_project_id.description: Logical producer/project identity, e.g. 'atlas-dataflow' or an external scientific-analysis project's stable logical id. Never an external filesystem root.

producer_revision_known.description: True when an immutable producer revision (e.g. a source repository revision) is genuinely known. False means the revision is explicitly unknown, not fabricated.

producer_revision.description: Immutable producer revision string when producer_revision_known is true; null when producer_revision_known is false.

input_references.description: Role identifiers of other artifact_references entries that this provenance record was derived from, if any.

generation_timestamp.description: Optional generation timestamp for this artifact, present only when meaningful beyond its content hash.

boundary_confirmations.description: Explicit confirmation that this manifest does not perform any forbidden embedding or role substitution. All flags are required and fixed.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this manifest was generated.
